questions.question_text: Identify the sentence that contains no grammatical errors.
options: The team of researchers were working on the project.
Each of the participants have completed the survey.
Neither the manager nor the employees were informed.
Data is usually plural, so it represent many facts.
questions.explanation: The verb should agree with the subject closest to it in 'neither/nor' constructions ('employees' is plural, so 'were' is correct).
Ephemeral refers to something lasting for a very short time.

questions.question_text: Which word is a synonym for 'Resilient'?
questions.explanation: Resilient means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.

options: Neither the manager nor the employees was present.
Neither the manager nor the employees were present.
Neither the manager nor the employees is present.
Neither the manager nor the employees has been present.
questions.explanation: When using neither/nor, the verb must agree with the subject closest to it (employees).
Amplify means to increase, so diminish is the opposite.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence: 'She ___ to the office every morning.'
What is the meaning of the idiom 'A blessing in disguise'?
options: A good thing that seemed bad at first
questions.explanation: It refers to a misfortune that eventually results in a positive outcome.

questions.question_text: Select the correct pronoun: 'Between you and ___ , I think this project will succeed.'
questions.explanation: Objects of prepositions should be in the objective case (me).

questions.question_text: Which word best completes the sentence: 'His ___ explanation cleared up all the confusion.'
questions.explanation: Lucid means expressed clearly and easy to understand.

questions.question_text: Identify the passive voice version of 'The AI model analyzed the data.'
options: The data was analyzed by the AI model.
The data is analyzed by the AI model.
The AI model is being analyzed by the data.
questions.explanation: Passive voice changes the focus to the object (the data) receiving the action.

questions.question_text: Which sentence contains a dangling modifier?
options: Walking down the street, the trees looked beautiful.
Walking down the street, I saw beautiful trees.
The trees looked beautiful while I was walking.
I saw beautiful trees as I walked down the street.
questions.explanation: The modifier 'Walking down the street' incorrectly modifies 'the trees' rather than a person.
The prefix 'Un-' is added to the base word 'predictable' to negate it.

questions.question_text: Which word is a synonym for 'Inherent'?
questions.explanation: Inherent refers to something that is an essential or permanent part of something.
